statement: The function returns a result r and r = true if and only if there exist bits R_i in {0,1} for 0 <= i < m and C_j in {0,1} for 0 <= j < n such that for every 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n, (grid[i][j] + R_i + C_j) mod 2 = 0. Here R_i = 1 means row i is flipped an odd number of times and C_j = 1 means column j is flipped an odd number of times; all other rows and columns are flipped an even number of times.
preconditions: Let m = len(grid) and n be the common length of the rows. Assume 1 <= m <= 300, 1 <= n <= 300, every row grid[i] has length n, and grid[i][j] is either 0 or 1 for all 0 <= i < m and 0 <= j < n.
